text:
rachel.t: starting staged rollout v2025.01 -> prod. plan: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> full. change window ends 04:30 UTC. release notes https://redwood.example/release/v2025.01
deploy-bot: Initiated rollout r-20250114-07. advancing to 5% in ~6m unless paused.
omar.f: quick FYI, ap-east has a heavy analytics job running until 04:10 UTC, recommend pin if we see tail.
kevin.l: noted. watch p95 and cache evictions when we hit 5%.
deploy-bot: Reached 5% at 1843210040. Holding per safety gate.
omar.f: seeing a small p99 tail on tokenizer service at ~1843210055 for long inputs, no 5xxs. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/tokenizer
rachel.t: propose split: pin ap-east to v2024.12 and continue elsewhere. quick vote: :thumbsup continue everywhere, :thumbsdown rollback globally, :hand pin ap-east and continue. 4m to vote.
kevin.l: :hand pin ap-east.
omar.f: :hand agreeing, will run the pin.
deploy-bot: queued pin job j-44123 for ap-east.
ops-bot: ap-east pin completed at 1843210090. traffic reverted to v2024.12.
rachel.t: pausing global rollout at 5% for 25m observation. rollback criteria: p95 >350ms sustained 10m OR errors >0.5%. update release notes with "partial-pin-ap-east".
kevin.l: starting targeted perf sweep on canary hosts, will post findings.
omar.f: thanks, will monitor analytics job overlap and confirm stability post-pin.
rachel.t: no full rollback yet; keep this thread as decision log. :mag:
